tools.name: chess_create_game
tools.description: Create a new game with player/arbiter/time-control schema. Returns the initial state. Fails if game_id already exists. Requires an arbiter : either the ``arbiter`` field is set to an IA agent id, or a local arbiter daemon must have published its pidfile in the games dir.

arbiter.description: IA agent id responsible for arbitration (any non-empty string). If omitted, a running local arbiter daemon must have claimed the games dir.

white_team.description: Relay game (#280) : registry ids of the players who hold white, humans and agents mixed ; ``white`` stays the team's name. Set at creation only, never changed.

rated.description: Elo perimeter (default true). Pass false for test, exercise or friendly games : no ``[Rated]`` header is written, so the game stays out of chess_get_elo, /api/elo and the matchmaking busy check. Strict JSON boolean only (a string like ``"false"`` is refused).

tools.name: chess_create_lesson
tools.description: Open a lesson (#323) between two registered players : the server gives the id ``cours.<theme>.<white>-<black>.<YYYYMMDD>-<NN>``, writes ``[Mode "cours"]``, no clock, unrated. The same operation as ``POST /api/lessons`` (viewer, Tablier), with the same refusals. Requires an arbiter, like ``chess_create_game``.

theme.description: Opening or motif, a-z, 0-9 and dashes, 24 max (``italienne``)

tools.name: chess_view_state
tools.description: Read-only snapshot of a game (metadata, FEN, ply, history, result).
tools.http_note: Instantané d'une partie (métadonnées, FEN, ply, historique, résultat) : en HTTP, GET /api/positions et GET /api/raw le couvrent en deux lectures ; écart noté dans #267.

tools.name: chess_list_games
tools.description: Enumerate games available on the shared board. Returns a list of summaries (game_id, white, black, result, ply, turn, is_game_over, mtime) sorted by mtime desc. Use ``player`` to filter to one agent's games (matches white OR black, case-insensitive). Use ``active_only=true`` to drop finished games. Malformed PGN files are skipped. Lets a caller discover its game_id without touching the filesystem.

player.description: Keep only games where white or black matches this identifier (case-insensitive).

active_only.description: Keep only games whose result is still ``*``.

tools.name: chess_get_elo
tools.description: Return current Elo ratings computed from the PGNs on the shared board. By default rebuilds from scratch (source of truth = PGN headers), then refreshes the ``ratings.json`` cache side-car. Pass ``cache_only=true`` for a read-only lookup that returns ``null`` if the cache is missing. Pass ``player`` to narrow the response to one entry. Pass ``include_history=true`` to get the per-game update trail (useful for post-mortem). K-factor : 40 provisional for the first 30 games, then 20 (FIDE standard).

player.description: Narrow the response to one player's rating. Normalised via ``normalize_identity`` (strip + lower + alias table), so ``Leader`` / ``devleader`` / ``LEADER`` all map to ``leader``.

cache_only.description: Skip the rebuild and read ``ratings.json`` as-is. Returns ``cache_hit=false`` + empty ``players`` if the cache is missing.

include_history.description: Include the ``history`` list (per-game Elo deltas with k-factor and before/after).

tools.name: chess_play_move
tools.description: Validate a SAN move against the live board and persist the PGN. Illegal/ambiguous SAN is rejected. Returns the new state. If ``expected_ply`` is supplied and the board has already advanced past it (concurrent writer), the call is rejected with ``code=STALE_PLY`` BEFORE the move is applied — the caller should re-read state and retry. With a clock, a move before it is started, or once the side to move has run out (the game then ends on time, the move is not played), is rejected with ``code=INVALID_STATE``. On every refusal ``reason`` is the French text the viewer shows for the same case (#332, French piece letters : R D T F C) ; test ``code``, not the text.

move_san.description: e.g. e4, Nf3, exd5, O-O, e8=Q+

expected_ply.description: Idempotence guard. If provided and ≠ current board.ply(), returns STALE_PLY without pushing.

tools.name: chess_resign
tools.description: Resign the game on behalf of one side. Updates result (0-1 if white resigns, 1-0 if black resigns), writes a termination note in the PGN, and clears any pending draw offer. Refused if the game is already over.

tools.name: chess_offer_draw
tools.description: Register a draw offer from one side, awaiting the other side's response (agree_draw or decline_draw). Idempotent when re-offering from the same side. Refused if the opposite side already has a pending offer.

tools.name: chess_agree_draw
tools.description: Accept a pending draw offer from the opposite side, ending the game with result 1/2-1/2. Refused if no offer is pending, or if the accepting side made the offer.

tools.name: chess_decline_draw
tools.description: Decline a pending draw offer from the opposite side. Clears the offer without ending the game. Playing a move implicitly declines too (see chess_play_move).

tools.name: chess_get_raw_pgn
tools.description: Return the raw PGN file content for a game.

tools.name: chess_post_commentary
tools.description: Append a ply-indexed commentary line to the per-game side-car log.

tools.name: chess_get_commentary
tools.description: Return commentary entries for a game (all or filtered by ply).

tools.name: chess_clock_state
tools.description: Return the clock snapshot for a game (white/black seconds, active side, flag_fall flag). Read with the token of a player of the game or of its arbiter, a clock at 0:00 ends the game on time ; anyone else's read changes nothing.

tools.name: chess_clock_start
tools.description: Start the clock for a game, against the side to move : White before the first move (FIDE 6.2.1, #330). Any participant may, whatever their side. Required before any move of a game with a clock, the first included, except tablier.* games, whose first move still starts it (until #335). Already started : unchanged. Error if the game has no clock (TimeControl=unrated), is over, or its clock was switched off.

tools.name: chess_board_facts
tools.description:
Faits vérifiables sur une position d'échecs — SANS évaluation. 

**Usage recommandé en trois temps (CD 2026-09-30)** :
1. **Prédis** — écris ta lecture dans ``expected`` avant l'appel (ex : « ma dame en e6 est défendue, rien ne la menace »). L'outil ne l'interprète pas, il te la renvoie telle quelle à côté des faits.
2. **Vérifie** — compare ta prédiction aux faits retournés. Si un écart saute aux yeux (pièce en prise que tu croyais défendue, clouage manqué…), c'est une leçon.
3. **Note la leçon dans ta mémoire** — l'outil produit des leçons, il ne les remplace pas. Nos poids ne bougent pas d'une partie à l'autre : ce qui s'accumule c'est la mémoire écrite. Le journal ``board_facts_log.jsonl`` donne la mesure : le taux d'écarts par partie devrait baisser si les leçons servent.

**Contenu retourné** : pour chaque pièce, case + attaquants et défenseurs (listes de {square, piece}, pas des compteurs). Pièces en prise : attaquées et non-défendues OU attaquées par une pièce de moindre valeur. Clouages absolus (contre le roi). Coups d'échec disponibles pour le camp au trait, en SAN. Avec ``move_san`` : simule le(s) coup(s) sur une COPIE du board — case d'arrivée, pièces nouvellement en prise (y compris par découverte). 

**Note ray-X** : ``board.attackers()`` ne voit pas les pièces alignées derrière (batteries) — les attackers listés ne sont pas une entrée SEE. 

**Interdit** : score, meilleur coup, ranking, variante, Stockfish.

game_id.description: Charge la position courante du game (exclusif avec fen)

move_san.description: Optionnel — string OU array de SAN. Simule le(s) coup(s) sur une COPIE du board (le game n'est PAS modifié), et renvoie les faits après chaque demi-coup : case d'arrivée, pièces nouvellement en prise, faits complets post-move, matériel. Séquence stoppée au 1er coup illégal avec ``stopped_at`` + ``error``, les coups légaux précédents sont conservés dans ``sequence``.

expected.description: Optionnel — ta prédiction en texte libre AVANT l'appel (ex : « dame en e6 défendue, rien ne la menace »). L'outil ne l'interprète pas : il te la renvoie telle quelle dans la réponse pour que l'écart avec les faits saute aux yeux. Si ``game_id`` est fourni, une ligne est ajoutée à ``~/.local/share/outillages/board_facts_log.jsonl`` (journal per-user sous le home du process MCP — chacun le sien, pas de partage cross-user) : ply, side_to_move, expected, résumé pièces en prise/clouages. Pas de verdict automatique, c'est toi qui juges l'écart. Override via env ``OUTILLAGES_BOARD_FACTS_LOG``.

tools.http_note: Faits vérifiables sur une position, sans évaluation, pour la lecture d'un agent ; le viewer montre l'échiquier et n'a pas de route de faits.

tools.name: chess_analyze_position
tools.description: Run local Stockfish on a position (game current FEN, or a specific ply, or a free-form FEN). Returns score in cp, best move, and principal variation. Refused on positions that belong to an in-progress game — call is logged in ``~/.local/share/outillages/engine_calls_log.jsonl`` either way.

caller.description: Agent identifier for the audit log (optional).

tools.name: chess_analyze_game
tools.description: Walk every ply of a game, evaluate before/after, classify each move as blunder/mistake/inaccuracy/good. Refused on in-progress games — audit entry written in all cases.

caller.description: Agent identifier for the audit log (optional).

tools.http_note: Analyse de chaque demi-coup d'une partie finie, coups classés ; le viewer n'évalue que la position courante (GET /api/engine/live).

tools.name: chess_get_my_mistakes
tools.description: Return the subset of one player's moves classified above min_classification (default inaccuracy). Refused on in-progress games — audit entry written in all cases.

caller.description: Agent identifier for the audit log (optional).

tools.http_note: Sous-ensemble des coups d'un joueur classés par chess_analyze_game ; le rapport coach HTTP (GET /api/coach/reports/{game_id}) est d'une autre nature et n'a pas d'outil : #265.

tools.name: chess_get_player_preferences
tools.description: Read player preferences (issue #38). ``max_concurrent`` = number of RATED games a player accepts in progress at once before the matchmaking treats them as busy (default 1). Unrated games never count. Omit ``player`` to list every stored preference.
tools.http_note: Préférence max_concurrent du matchmaking entre agents (#38) ; le viewer ne fait pas de matchmaking.

tools.name: chess_set_player_preferences
tools.description: Set a player's ``max_concurrent`` (integer 1..10). Only affects the matchmaking busy check : creating games stays unlimited. Stored outside the PGNs. Identity is not verified yet (registry of #34) : set only your own preference.
tools.http_note: Préférence max_concurrent du matchmaking entre agents (#38) ; le viewer ne fait pas de matchmaking.

tools.name: chess_whoami
tools.description: Who this call's Bearer token is (#266), like GET /api/me : ``authenticated``, ``player`` and ``kind``. Without a valid token the answer is anonymous (authenticated false), never an error : use it to check a client's configuration before the strict mode of #34.

tools.name: chess_seat
tools.description: The sides this call's token holds in a game (#266), like GET /api/games/{id}/seat : ``player`` and ``colors``. Nothing is played. Errors : UNAUTHENTICATED (no valid token), NOT_A_PLAYER, GAME_NOT_FOUND ; ``reason`` carries the viewer's French text (#332).
